title: [Bot Refactor] Enhance API health checks, response compression and CI pipeline
body:
## Summary

This PR introduces performance optimizations and reliability enhancements for the .NET Server and adds robust frontend validation to the CI pipeline.

## Changes

- **Response Compression**: Added `app.UseResponseCompression()` which was configured but never enabled in the middleware pipeline, improving data transfer efficiency.
- **Health Checks**: Implemented `AddHealthChecks()` and `MapHealthChecks("/api/health")` for better monitoring and Azure App Service integration.
- **GitHub Actions Improvements**: 
  - Updated Actions versions from deprecated `actions/setup-dotnet@v5` and `upload-artifact@v7` to stable `@v4`.
  - Added a dedicated job `lint-and-build-client` to statically check and build the React Vite frontend upon pull requests, preventing broken UI changes from passing CI.

## Testing

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Manual testing completed
